title: Semantic Needles in Document Haystacks: Sensitivity Testing of LLM-as-a-Judge Similarity Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2604.18835v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a scalable, multifactorial experimental framework that systematically probes LLM sensitivity to subtle semantic changes in pairwise document comparison. We analogize this as a needle-in-a-haystack problem: a single semantically altered sentence (the needle) is embedded within surrounding context (the hay), and we vary the perturbation type (negation, conjunction swap, named entity replacement), context type (original vs. topically unrelated), needle position, and document length across all combinations, testing seven LLMs on tens of thousands of document pairs. Our analysis reveals several striking findings. First, LLMs can exhibit a within-document positional bias distinct from previously studied candidate-order effects: some models penalize semantic differences more harshly when they occur earlier in a document. translated_title: 文档干草堆中的语义之针：LLM作为评判者的相似度评分敏感性测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个可扩展的多因素实验框架，系统地探究LLM在成对文档比较中对细微语义变化的敏感性。我们将其类比为“大海捞针”问题：一个语义被修改的句子（针）被嵌入到周围的上下文（干草）中，我们在所有组合下变化扰动类型（否定、连词交换、命名实体替换）、上下文类型（原始上下文与主题无关上下文）、针的位置以及文档长度，并在数万个文档对上测试了七个LLM。我们的分析揭示了几个惊人的发现。首先，LLM可能表现出一种不同于先前研究的候选顺序效应的文档内位置偏差：一些模型在语义差异出现在文档较早位置时会对其惩罚更严厉。其次，当被修改的句子被主题无关的上下文包围时，它会提高相似度评分……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个可扩展的多因素实验框架，通过“大海捞针”式的成对文档比较系统测试七个LLM的相似度评分敏感性，并揭示了包括与候选顺序效应不同的文档内位置偏差在内的多种惊人发现。
